# Rime

> Rime is a React component kit with frosted-glass surfaces: Next.js App Router, TypeScript, CSS Modules and CSS custom properties, no Tailwind and no component library underneath. It installs like shadcn/ui (the shadcn CLI copies the source into your project) and names its items as shadcn does. Each project re-themes it with one theme.css made in Rime Studio (https://rime.mjsons.net/themes). Two presets, Rime Default (frosted glass in Frost blue) and Rime Flat, each in light and dark mode.

Read the rules before writing UI code with these components:

- Import primitives from "@/components/ui" (the barrel). Shells come from "@/components/shell/*".
- Never restyle a primitive from a screen. Theme it with CSS custom properties (tokens) instead: system tokens in app/styles/tokens.css, per-component tokens (--button-radius, --input-height-md, --table-head-fill) at :root or on a wrapper.
- CSS Modules only. No Tailwind, no inline colour values, no new component library.
- No heavy rounding beyond the theme's scale, no scale-up or lift on hover, no bento grids, no left accent bars, no decorative background effects that do not derive from the product.
- No eyebrow or small label stacked over a title. Text uses the full width of its column: no narrow measure caps.
- Summary stats are one card with hairline cells, never a grid of separate stat cards.
- Filters are dropdowns (Select chips) plus one full-width search, never a row of toggle chips. Sortable table headers are the whole cell; pagination is centred under the table.
- One primary button (the brand gradient) per view. One table look everywhere. Modal and sheet headers keep one left edge.
- Every list page is GlassPanel > FilterBar + Table + Pagination, with nothing above it.
- Every component needs its loading, empty, error and disabled states; an empty state always says what to do next.
- Text contrast 4.5:1 minimum (3:1 for focus rings and control edges). Fill colours like --brand-soft and --danger-base are never text.
- In Next.js, gate access inside page.tsx, never in layout.tsx (a layout gate leaks the page into the RSC payload).
- No em dashes in copy.

## Install

- Everything: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/kit`
- One component: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/<item>` (item names follow shadcn: button, dialog, dropdown-menu, select, sheet, sonner...)
- The agent docs and Claude skill for a project: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/agents`
- Registry: https://rime.mjsons.net/r/registry.json. Namespace @rime for components.json: "@rime": "https://rime.mjsons.net/r/{name}.json". The shadcn MCP server (npx shadcn@latest mcp) then lists, searches and installs Rime items.
- Styles, imported first in app/globals.css: app/styles/tokens.css, app/styles/base.css, app/styles/shadcn-bridge.css, then the project's theme.css.

## Coming from shadcn

| shadcn | Rime | Install item |
| --- | --- | --- |
| button | Button (variant default→primary, destructive→danger, outline→secondary; link and icon sizes as in shadcn) | button |
| button-group | ButtonGroup | button-group |
| card | Card (+ CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent...) (props (title, description, actions, footer) or the shadcn parts) | card |
| dialog | Modal, ConfirmModal | dialog |
| alert-dialog | AlertDialog | alert-dialog |
| sheet, drawer | Sheet, Drawer | sheet |
| dropdown-menu | Menu | dropdown-menu |
| context-menu | ContextMenu | context-menu |
| menubar | Menubar | menubar |
| navigation-menu | NavigationMenu | navigation-menu |
| popover | Popover | popover |
| hover-card | HoverCard | hover-card |
| tooltip | Tooltip, Toggletip | tooltip |
| command | Command, CommandDialog | command |
| input | TextInput | input |
| input-group | InputGroup | input-group |
| input-otp | OtpInput | input-otp |
| textarea | Textarea | textarea |
| label | Label | label |
| field, form | Field, ErrorSummary | field |
| checkbox | Checkbox | checkbox |
| radio-group | RadioGroup | radio-group |
| switch | Switch | switch |
| slider | Slider | slider |
| select | Select (searchable option) | select |
| combobox | Combobox | combobox |
| calendar, date-picker | Calendar, DateField, DateRangeFilter | date-field |
| toggle, toggle-group | Toggle, ToggleGroup | toggle |
| tabs | FolderTabs, SegmentedControl | tabs |
| accordion | Accordion | accordion |
| collapsible | Collapsible | collapsible |
| breadcrumb | Breadcrumb | breadcrumb |
| pagination | Pagination (in Table) | table |
| table, data-table | Table + FilterBar + Pagination (the list page pattern) | table |
| badge | Badge, StatusPill, CountBadge | badge |
| avatar | Avatar | avatar |
| separator | Divider | separator |
| progress | Meter, ProgressBar | progress |
| skeleton | Skeleton | skeleton |
| spinner | Spinner | spinner |
| kbd | Kbd | kbd |
| alert | Alert | alert |
| sonner, toast | Toast + ToastProvider | sonner |
| empty | EmptyState | empty |
| scroll-area | ScrollArea | scroll-area |
| aspect-ratio | AspectRatio | aspect-ratio |
| carousel | Carousel | carousel |
| resizable | ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle | resizable |
| chart | LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, DonutChart, ChartContainer | chart |
| sidebar | SidebarShell (components/shell) | sidebar |

shadcn CSS variable names are aliases of Rime tokens (app/styles/shadcn-bridge.css), one way only:

| shadcn variable | Rime token |
| --- | --- |
| --background | --page-base |
| --foreground | --ink-body |
| --card / --card-foreground | --surface-solid / --ink-body |
| --popover / --popover-foreground | --popover-surface / --ink-body |
| --primary / --primary-foreground | --brand-action / --ink-inverse |
| --secondary / --secondary-foreground | --surface-sunken / --ink-heading |
| --muted / --muted-foreground | --surface-sunken / --ink-muted |
| --accent / --accent-foreground | --wash-hover / --ink-heading |
| --destructive | --danger-base-solid |
| --border | --line |
| --input | --line-input |
| --ring | --focus-color |
| --radius | --r-md |
| --chart-1..5 | --chart-1..5 |
| --sidebar* | --chrome-sidebar, --brand-action, --wash-active, --line-soft |
| --font-sans / --font-heading | --font-body / --font-display |

Dark mode is the .dark class or data-mode="dark" on <html>; Rime Flat is data-theme="flat".

## Docs

- [Everything in one file](https://rime.mjsons.net/llms-full.txt): every component, pattern and rule
- [Theming and tokens](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/theme.md): token layers, presets and modes, how to theme a project
- [Patterns](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md): composed patterns (list page, shells, sign-in, terms gate)
- Any docs page as markdown: add .md to its URL (for example /components/button.md).

## Actions

- [Button](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/button.md): The action control: primary gradient, glass secondary, ghost, and two danger forms, in three sizes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/button`
- [ButtonGroup](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/button-group.md): Joins Buttons and IconButtons into one segmented row or column with shared outer corners. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/button-group`
- [IconButton](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/icon-button.md): A square action with only an icon, a required accessible label and a tooltip-friendly hit area. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/icon-button`

## Forms

- [Calendar](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/calendar.md): The month grid on its own: a single date or a range, one or two months, with month and year pickers. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/date-field`
- [Checkbox](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/checkbox.md): A native checkbox drawn as a gradient tick, plain or as a selectable card, with indeterminate. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/checkbox`
- [Combobox](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/combobox.md): A text field that filters a list of options as you type and picks one, with optional create. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/combobox`
- [DateField](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/date-field.md): A typed DD/MM/YYYY field with a calendar popover, min/max and a date-of-birth preset. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/date-field`
- [DateRangeFilter](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/date-range-filter.md): A date-range chip for filter rows: presets plus a two-month range calendar. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/date-range-filter`
- [DateTimeField and DateTimeRangeField](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/date-time-field.md): A date and a time of day on one row, each with its own popup; the range variant pairs a start and end. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/date-time-field`
- [ErrorSummary](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/error-summary.md): The list of form errors at the top of a form, focused on submit, each linking to its field. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/error-summary`
- [Field](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/field.md): Label, hint, error and required marker for any control, wired through context. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/field`
- [FileDrop](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/file-drop.md): A drop zone and file picker with type and size checks and per-file status chips. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/file-drop`
- [InputGroup](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/input-group.md): A text field with addons joined to it: a fixed text segment, an icon, or a button such as Copy. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/input-group`
- [Label](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/label.md): A standalone form label with required and optional markers, for controls outside a Field. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/label`
- [OtpInput](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/otp-input.md): A six-cell one-time code entry with paste, auto-advance and onComplete. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/otp-input`
- [PrefixedInput](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/prefixed-input.md): A fixed-format code with a set prefix: an invoice number, an account code, a membership number. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/prefixed-input`
- [RadioGroup](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/radio-group.md): One choice from a few: a list, inline, or cards in 1 to 3 columns. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/radio-group`
- [SearchField](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/search-field.md): Field-size search on the grey frosted recess: clear button, loading state and an optional key hint. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/search-field`
- [Select](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/select.md): A custom listbox: a recessed field or filter chip that opens a frosted popover, optionally searchable. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/select`
- [Slider](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/slider.md): Picks a number or a range by dragging along a track, with steps, marks and a value readout. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/slider`
- [Switch](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/switch.md): An on/off setting that takes effect immediately, with a loading state while it saves. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/switch`
- [Textarea](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/textarea.md): Multi-line text in the TextInput box, resizable vertically, with an optional character count. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/textarea`
- [TextInput](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/text-input.md): The text field: a white box with a tinted edge, a brand halo on focus, adornments and a password reveal. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/text-input`
- [TimeField and TimeRangeField](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/time-field.md): A time of day with typed input and a popup picker; the range variant pairs start and end on one row. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/time-field`
- [Toggle](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/toggle.md): A two-state button, pressed or not, for toolbar formatting and view options. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/toggle`
- [ToggleGroup](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/toggle-group.md): A set of toggles sharing one value: single (a clearable radio set) or multiple. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/toggle`

## Data display

- [Avatar](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/avatar.md): Initials on the brand gradient or a neutral disc, in three sizes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/avatar`
- [Chart](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/chart.md): Themed charts on Recharts: line, area, bar and donut in one frame with a table view, plus sparklines and a stat strip. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/charts`
- [Kbd and KbdGroup](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/kbd.md): Keyboard keys as small raised key caps, alone or as a combination. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/kbd`
- [Meter and ProgressBar](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/meter.md): A segmented meter for small counts (seats used) and a bar for progress through a total. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/meter`
- [ProgressSteps](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/progress-steps.md): A horizontal track of steps with detail and meta lines, or a compact dot track for table cells. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/progress-steps`
- [StatusPill, Badge and CountBadge](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/status-pill.md): Status pills (tinted fill, tinted edge, deep ink), small uppercase tags, and count badges. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/badge`
- [Table](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/table.md): The one table look: neutral header row, whole-cell sortable headers, skeleton, empty and error states, and Pagination. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/table`

## Navigation

- [Breadcrumb](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/breadcrumb.md): Where this page sits: a trail of links ending on the current page, folding its middle into a menu when long. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/breadcrumb`
- [FilterBar](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/filter-bar.md): The one filter row above every table: a growing search, dropdown chips at the end, clear, and the list's own action. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/filter-bar`
- [FolderTabs and SegmentedControl](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/tabs.md): Folder tabs that sit on a glass panel with always-visible counts, and a segmented control for views. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/tabs`
- [NavigationMenu](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/navigation-menu.md): Top-level site navigation with frosted dropdown panels of described links, built as disclosure navigation. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/navigation-menu`
- [NavSearch and SmartSearch](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/nav-search.md): Top-bar search: NavSearch jumps to pages and actions; SmartSearch queries records with grouped results. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/nav-search`
- [Pagination](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/pagination.md): Centred page buttons with previous and next, gaps for long ranges, and a summary line at the left. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/table`
- [Stepper](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/stepper.md): The wizard's step list: lettered markers, states, and optional navigation back to finished steps. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/stepper`

## Feedback

- [Alert](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/alert.md): An inline message in a tone (info, success, warning, danger) or a quiet legal box for fixed wording, with an action and dismiss. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/alert`
- [EmptyState](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/empty-state.md): What an empty list means and what to do next: default, positive (all done) and filtered tones. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/empty-state`
- [ImpactPreview](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/impact-preview.md): What a destructive action will change, row by row, before it is confirmed. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/impact-preview`
- [Skeleton](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/skeleton.md): Loading placeholders shaped like the content they stand in for, with a soft shimmer. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/skeleton`
- [Spinner](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/spinner.md): A small brand-tinted spinner for in-flight work inside buttons, fields and panels. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/spinner`
- [Toast](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/toast.md): Frosted toasts for success, error, info and in-flight work, stacked as a deck that fans out on hover. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/toast`

## Overlays

- [AlertDialog](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/alert-dialog.md): A short interrupting confirm with Cancel and one action; focus starts on Cancel and the scrim never dismisses it. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/alert-dialog`
- [Command](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/command.md): A command palette: a search box over grouped actions with shortcuts, keyboard-first, inline or as a Ctrl+K dialog. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/command`
- [ContextMenu](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/context-menu.md): A menu of actions for a region, opened at the pointer with a right-click, Shift+F10 or a long press. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/context-menu`
- [HoverCard](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/hover-card.md): A rich preview on hover or keyboard focus of a link: a person, a project, a record. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/hover-card`
- [Menu](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/menu.md): An action menu from a button: groups, headings, separators, icons, links and danger items, in a frosted popover. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/menu`
- [Menubar](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/menubar.md): A desktop application menu bar (File, Edit, View) with keyboard navigation across and within its menus. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/menubar`
- [Modal](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/modal.md): A frosted dialog with a focus trap, scroll lock, inert page, scroll-aware edges and a bottom sheet on phones. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/modal`
- [Popover](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/popover.md): An anchored frosted panel for arbitrary content: a short form, a set of options, a details block. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/popover`
- [Sheet and Drawer](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/sheet.md): A panel that slides in from an edge over a scrim, and a bottom Drawer with a drag handle. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/sheet`
- [Tooltip and Toggletip](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/tooltip.md): Hover and focus tooltips (dark one-liners or light rich cards) and click-to-open toggletips for help. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/tooltip`
- [TypeToConfirmModal and DangerZone](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/type-to-confirm.md): The heaviest confirm: an impact preview and a typed phrase; and the Danger zone section that leads to it. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/type-to-confirm`

## Layout and surfaces

- [Accordion](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/accordion.md): Stacked sections that open and close in place: one at a time or several, on glass or plain hairlines. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/accordion`
- [AspectRatio](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/aspect-ratio.md): A box held to a width-to-height ratio, so media keeps its shape and never shifts the layout while loading. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/aspect-ratio`
- [Card](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/card.md): A solid card with a washed header, a lifted highlight tone, and a sunken muted tone. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/card`
- [Carousel](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/carousel.md): A row of slides on a native scroll-snap track, with frosted prev and next buttons, dots and arrow keys. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/carousel`
- [Collapsible](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/collapsible.md): One disclosure: a title row with a toggle, an always-visible summary and a region that opens beneath it. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/collapsible`
- [Divider](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/divider.md): A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, optionally labelled, with spacing steps. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/divider`
- [GlassPanel](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/glass-panel.md): Frosted glass over the page field: page, light and nested variants, padding steps and an optional bloom. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/glass-panel`
- [Resizable](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/resizable.md): Panels split by draggable hairline handles, side by side or stacked, with keyboard resizing and minimum sizes. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/resizable`
- [ScrollArea, useScrollEdges and useScrollLock](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/scroll-area.md): The modal's scroll, made portable: thin tinted scrollbars, contained overscroll, edge shadows and a shared scroll lock. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/scroll-area`

## Shell

- [AuthCard and AuthLayout](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/auth-card.md): The sign-in card: a solid card on a deep field, with a logo slot, icon tile, title, footer strip and back link. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/auth-card`
- [PageHeader](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/page-header.md): A page's h1 with a back link, a meta line, a description and actions. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/page-header`
- [SidebarShell](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/sidebar-shell.md): The signed-in frame in four layouts: an expanded frosted sidebar, a collapsible icon rail, a header-only top nav, and a drawer on narrow screens. Install: `npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/sidebar-shell`

## Patterns

- [List page](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#list-page): One glass panel holding the filter row, the table and the pagination. Nothing above it.
- [Frosted glass shell](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#glass-shell): The signed-in frame: the page field painted once, a frosted sidebar and top bar over it, and glass panels inside.
- [Shell: sidebar expanded](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#shell-sidebar): The default signed-in frame: a full-height frosted sidebar and top bar forming one glass L, the logo corner in the same glass.
- [Shell: collapsible icon rail](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#shell-rail): The same frame with a panel button that folds the sidebar to a 68px icon rail, remembered across visits.
- [Shell: header only](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#shell-header): No sidebar: the logo, a short horizontal nav and the profile in one frosted top bar, the page below at full width.
- [Shell: mobile drawer](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#shell-drawer): On narrow screens the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer from a menu button, with a scrim, a focus hold and Esc to close.
- [Summary card with cells](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#summary-card): One card of key figures: per cell a label, a big number and a muted line of context, separated by hairlines.
- [Modal with scroll edges](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#modal-scroll): A long modal whose header and footer cast shadows only when content passes under them.
- [Terms with scroll-gated accept](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#terms-gated): A terms dialog whose Accept stays disabled until the reader has scrolled to the end.
- [Sign-in with multi-factor authentication](https://rime.mjsons.net/md/patterns.md#sign-in): A corporate sign-in: brand mark in the header, the form centred, a shield treatment and a security note in the footer, across the password, MFA code and authenticator setup steps.
